approval_basis: Explicit user instruction to continue the prepared gate.

decisions.statement: Approve the six-mode foundation drill cycle RECOGNIZE_INTENT → REPEAT_FORM → PRODUCE_QUESTION → TRACE_GIDS → PRODUCE_RESPONSE → MICRO_DIALOGUE for each source OPI in Activation P01.
Approve slots 001-006 as valid drills of OPI 1 while preserving KALA YA EN ES KU KE as a whole-utterance formula and keeping YA/ES unresolved.
Approve slots 007-012 as valid drills of OPI 2 using EN VAMAKALA KE and the already validated [NICKNAME] / NE VAMAKALA answer routes, without creating a HAVE verb or global negation rule.
Approve TRACE_GIDS as structural training using authoritative G-IDs while continuing to treat Candidate D glyph drawings as PREPRODUCTION_NOT_OFFICIAL.
Confirm that P01 is new SimpleWay HNK v1.1 authorship derived from validated OPI and is not a reconstruction of the unrecovered historical 72-drill payload.

explicit_non_effects: Does not claim the 12 drills are historical v1.0 drills.
Does not create new HNK lexical forms.
Does not promote any language authority.
Does not make Candidate D drawings official visual canon.
Does not promote any Activation slot to FROZEN.
